About Occibo

Occibo is an AI-powered SaaS platform for children's book creation, built by IndieKidz GmbH in Berlin. We're a small, remote-first team looking for a QA intern to help us build and maintain automated testing so we can ship new features quickly and with confidence.

● Translate product requirements into automated checks, including edge cases

● Collaborate with the development team on test data strategies and stable selectors

● Run tests in CI, track failures, and help keep the test suite reliable

● Use AI tools to speed up test creation, analysis, and maintenance

Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, Jest, Vitest, GitHub Actions

● Currently enrolled in CS, Software Engineering, or a related field

● Experience with at least one test automation framework (Playwright or Cypress preferred)

● Comfortable with JavaScript or TypeScript and Git

● Understanding of CI pipelines and reliable test design

● Interest in AI and experience using AI tools

● Fluent English

Benefits

● Hands-on experience with a real product, not a classroom exercise

● Direct collaboration with the founder and development team

● A portfolio of shipped QA work you can show future employers

Nice to have

● Prior SaaS UI automation experience

● API testing experience (Postman or REST clients)

● Based in Berlin and able to join onsite occasionally

How to apply

Send a message with your CV, short note/cover letter(preferred), your best project link, the test framework you know, and your availability and start date.

We are looking for candidates available to start in October 2026.

Aufgaben Als Werkstudent:in im digitalen Produktmanagement arbeitest du an den verschiedenen digitalen Produkten und Zukunftsthemen der Pflegehelden. Dazu gehören unser eigenentwickeltes CRM, der Heldenplaner, sowie unsere App und das Support-Ticketsystem. Außerdem beschäftigen wir uns intensiv damit, wie wir bestehende Prozesse mithilfe von KI vereinfachen und verbessern können. Der Heldenplaner bildet den gesamten Vermittlungsprozess ab und wird täglich von unseren Franchise-Partner:innen, Vermittlungsagenturen und Mitarbeitenden genutzt. Du unterstützt die Head of Product und das Entwicklungsteam über den gesamten Produktprozess hinweg, von der ersten Idee und der Analyse bestehender Abläufe bis zum erfolgreichen Einsatz neuer Funktionen. Was dich bei uns konkret erwartet: Du testest neue Funktionen im Heldenplaner und in der App, dokumentierst die Ergebnisse und unterstützt bei der fachlichen Abnahme. Du bearbeitest Supportanfragen aus unserem Ticketsystem, klärst Anliegen mit unseren Nutzer:innen und erkennst wiederkehrende Fragen / Probleme. Daraus leitest du Verbesserungen für unsere Produkte und Prozesse ab. Du formulierst verständliche Entwicklungstickets, ergänzt Akzeptanzkriterien und klärst offene fachliche Fragen. Du unterstützt bei Recherchen, Konzepten und einfachen Prototypen. Dabei erprobst du unter anderem, wie wir Prozesse mithilfe von KI effizienter gestalten können. Du unterstützt uns dabei, Produkt-, Nutzungs- und Prozessdaten aufzubereiten und auszuwerten. Dabei wirkst du an Dashboards und Analysen in Power BI mit und hilfst uns, datenbasierte Erkenntnisse für unsere Produkte abzuleiten. Du begleitest Rollouts und erstellst verständliche Anleitungen, Release-Informationen und Schulungsunterlagen. Du übernimmst schrittweise eigene Themen und hältst Vereinbarungen sowie offene Aufgaben zuverlässig nach. Deine Aufgaben sind bewusst vielseitig. Partner-facing value propositions live in market, with at least two partners actively selling an Awin-enabled proposition of their own. Referenceable partners willing to advocate publicly, at least one flagship case study in market, and Awin represented on stage at relevant industry events. Measurable advertiser-side pull-through from the partnerships landed, agreed jointly with the advertiser teams.   Key Skills 7+ years in commercial, partnership or account leadership roles, with a significant portion earned publisher-side or media-owner-side. An established personal network of senior contacts across the media and publishing world that can be activated from day one. This is a prerequisite, not a nice-to-have. Experience representing an organisation publicly: speaking at industry events, on panels or at partner forums. Demonstrable track record of senior-level relationships inside premium publishers or media groups, including commercial directors, heads of ecommerce, editorial and digital leadership. Experience negotiating and closing commercial agreements with, or on behalf of, publishers: tenancy, CPC, CPA, fixed fee, data or licensing deals. Working knowledge of the affiliate and performance ecosystem and how publishers monetise content, for example Awin, Skimlinks, Rakuten, Partnerize, Impact or similar. cards.announcement: Purpose of Position Own the product agenda for how AI creates real, measurable value across Awin — translating AI capability into shipped product outcomes, not experiments.  Context   Thousands of advertisers and publishers who stay on Awin platform because of the people and product behind the service. The next chapter of Awin's product strategy is defined by how deliberately we put AI to work — not as a slogan, but as a set of practical capabilities embedded into what we build and how the business runs.   Most companies treat AI as a layer bolted onto existing product thinking. We want the opposite: a Head of Product who treats AI as core to the product strategy itself — where it belongs, what it should never touch, and how it compounds value over time rather than producing one-off wins.   What you'll own   Product strategy for AI-driven value. Define where AI genuinely changes the economics or experience of our product — and where it doesn't. Prioritise like a product leader: value creation and value capture, not novelty. Translate capability into roadmap. Convert what AI can practically do today into a prioritised, sequenced product agenda with clear outcomes — not a lab of disconnected pilots. Own outcomes, not outputs. Every initiative under your remit is judged on measurable business impact — adoption, efficiency, revenue, or customer outcome — not on whether something "uses AI." Partner at exec level. Work directly with leadership to align AI investment with company priorities, and defend that investment in commercial terms. Lead a product team. Hire and develop the product talent needed to execute — with real ownership over people and budget. Set the standard for build vs. buy. Make disciplined calls on when to adopt existing AI tooling versus build proprietary capability, with opportunity cost as the deciding factor. Champion practical adoption over theatre. Internal and external users are your test of success — if a capability isn't used, it isn't done.     Who you are   Product leader with technical fluency. You've run product organisations and you understand, in practical terms, where AI creates leverage versus where it's a distraction. Outcome-obsessed. You think in business impact first, technology second. Commercially sharp. You can defend a roadmap in P&L terms as comfortably as in a product review. Credible with engineering. You can go deep enough on data, APIs, and model capability to make good calls, without needing to be the one building it. A builder of teams, not just plans — you know how to hire and develop product talent that ships.   What success looks like   A clear, prioritised AI product agenda in place; first initiatives shipped with measurable adoption. A functioning product team; multiple AI-enabled capabilities live and driving demonstrable business outcomes. AI is a defining, differentiated part of Awin's product experience — not a side initiative, but core to how the product wins in market.   What this role is not Not an automation function. Not a central bureaucracy that runs projects for other teams. Not a lab for AI experimentation without a business case. Wir sind der europäische Marktführer im Bereich App-Discovery und Mobile Gaming. Mit einer Reichweite von Millionen an Nutzer:innen weltweit entwickeln, erwerben und skalieren wir Tech-Produkte, die begeistern. Wir arbeiten mit hoher Autonomie, hohem Tempo und ohne unnötigen Schnickschnack. Wenn du ein Konzernumfeld mit endlosen Freigabeschleifen suchst, bist du hier falsch. Wenn du Verantwortung übernehmen, mutige Ideen testen und deine Karriere in Marketing durchstarten möchtest, dann willkommen zu Hause! Performance Marketing: Hilf beim Erstellen, Tracking und Optimieren von bezahlten Werbekampagnen – und verbinde dabei dein kreatives Gespür mit scharfer Analytik. Dein Profil Fließend in Englisch & Deutsch: Beide Sprachen sollten sicher in Wort und Schrift beherrscht werden. Social Media Native: Du lebst und atmest aktuelle Trends, Memes und Plattform-Formate. Ein eigener Social-Media-Kanal mit ein paar tausend Followern ist ein großes Plus! Erste Erfahrungen: Vorherige Erfahrungen aus einem Marketing-Praktikum, einer Werkstudententätigkeit oder einem Side-Hustle sind ein großer Vorteil. Werde Teil der Community: Nimm an regelmäßigen Team- und Unternehmensevents teil, darunter Hackathons und Social Gatherings. Wir arbeiten nicht nur zusammen – wir feiern auch zusammen! Bereit für das nächste Level? Bewirb dich jetzt und vergiss nicht, Links zu deinen Social-Media-Profilen oder deinem Portfolio beizufügen! At justDice, we value ownership, honesty, collaboration, and having fun while building something ambitious together. We care about hiring great people, not perfect CVs.
